scientific integrity: The infinite optimization is proved analytically by separate convexity, exact support-function reduction, and exact envelope comparisons. The bundled symbolic checker replays the support and algebraic steps but is not used as a substitute for the proof.
scientific limitations: The result is restricted to the real regular-octagonal plane and to the parameter range 0<=alpha<1. Targeted database and full-text searches cannot exclude every unindexed or differently phrased source.
title: Exact quadratic isosceles-orthogonality profile of the regular octagonal plane
